installCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const cmd=fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')?'npm install && npm --prefix frontend install':'npm install';cp.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'});"
buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const cmd=fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')?'npm --prefix frontend run build':'npm run build';cp.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'});"
